Definition: Beer-Elim, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Beer-elim is a place in Moab, the well of Elim, named once in Isaiah's burden against Moab. The cry of the land goes round its borders when judgment comes.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the well's name is a small mercy in a hard oracle, because even in the judgment on Moab the well of God is named.
